mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1.0% compresses equity discount rates and increases risk appetite, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market health, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE increases by >0.5pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.8% each month indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering earnings revisions downward and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a 0.5% monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing slowdowns that reduce near-term profit visibility, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, INDPRO declines >0.5% do not yield negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent price pressures that accelerate Fed tightening expectations, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly employment growth above 150,000 jobs (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate revenue visibility, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 150000.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production (INDPRO) decline below 104.0 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces near-term corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 104.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent quarterly GDP contraction (GDPC1 < 0) and monthly housing starts decline (HOUST < 0.5%) indicate severe economic slowdown, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in GDPC1 and HOUST fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.
